integrity: The infinite classification is proved directly from alternation and nesting. An independent finite replay through total part size five compares all double-occurrence words against words generated by the structural form and checks exact linear counts, cyclic counts, and square-freeness.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the 2-uniform representation-number layer of labeled complete bipartite graphs. It does not count higher-uniformity square-free representants, which are infinite in number for non-complete connected word-representable graphs, and it does not extend to arbitrary bipartite circle graphs.
title: All two-uniform representations of complete bipartite graphs
